title: We're making Little Links Golf, a cozy golf course builder coming to Steam in 2027!
author: Three_Tails_Studio
selftext:
Hi everyone! 👋

We're Three Tails Studio, and we've been building **Little Links Golf**: a cozy golf course sim in the spirit of the classic course builders.

**Build it.** Place a tee, set the green, paint the fairway between them, then dig bunkers, flood ponds and plant every tree by hand. Each hole earns a rating, and the very best become Legendary.

**Run it**. Grow a whole club around your course: the clubhouse and pro shop, restaurants, a driving range, tennis courts, a lakeside lodge. Hire groundskeepers, sign members, set your green fees and host tournaments while the weather and seasons change around you.

**Play it**. Create your golfer and walk out to the first tee of the course you made. Pick a club, shape a draw or a fade, read the break on the green, and see if your own design beats you.

**Watch out for Jimothy**. He's a raccoon. He is not a member. Please don't sell him a membership. (Keep an eye on the tree line, too. Not every visitor is a golfer.)

🏌️ **The full game: PC on Steam, 2027**

Little Links Golf is a full PC release coming to Steam next year, and it's in active development right now.

⛳ **Little Links Golf Lite: our closed beta**

While we build the full game, we've made **Little Links Golf Lite**, a small browser version you can play right now if you're in the closed beta. It's an early proof of concept: it lets us test ideas, find bugs, and hear from real golfers while the full game takes shape.

To be clear, the browser version **isn't a representation of what the full PC release will look like**. It's a fun little taste we wanted to give our golfers while we cook!

**How the beta works**:

\* It's **invite onl**y. Each tester gets their own personal beta key.

\* Play in **Chrome or Edge** on a desktop or laptop.

\* Spot something odd? Press **F8** in the game to send us a bug report, screenshot and all.

**Want in?** Head to the website and ask to join. We're inviting testers in small groups:

👉 [**https://threetailsstudios.com**](https://threetailsstudios.com/)

We'd love to hear what you think, what you'd want in a golf course builder, and which classic sims you grew up on. Thanks for reading, and see you on the first tee! 🐾

**Three Tails Studio**
